messages:
Jordan: Quick heads-up — all-hands in 30m. Stream starts at 10:00 PT. Small agenda tweak: product roadmap Q&A moved to after the leadership update. Please hold detailed questions for the live Q&A thread. Recording will be on, need a mic check before we go live.
Sara K: noted. Can we swap slides so PMs present before infra?
Mike L: Need that — infra is a quick 3-slide rollout update, can go after PMs.
Jordan: @Mike L good. @Ashley P can you do a mic check with @StreamBot in ~10 minutes?
StreamBot: ScheduledStream: all-hands. Running automated health check... OK. OBS scene 'All-hands' loaded. Recording target: s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/1769001234.mp4
Ashley P: mic check plan — I'll DM folks. When I ask, please say: "Redwood Inference check 1 2" briefly.
Emily R: also please confirm captions are enabled (we had them off last time).
Jordan: @OpsBot can you confirm captions and that the stream key hasn't rotated?
OpsBot: captions: enabled. stream_key: valid (no rotation). CDN edge health: 99.98%. Ops on standby.
Mike L: fyi last all-hands had duplicate audio tracks — anyone know the usual culprit?
Ashley P: usually OBS capturing both mic and system audio. I'll set scenes to use only 'Mic/Aux' and uncheck desktop audio for the 'All-hands' scene.
Sara K: Devex has a 2-min demo that might overrun. Can we shrink roadmap Q&A to 10m to keep time?
Jordan: yes — reducing roadmap Q&A to 10m. Leadership office hours after the meeting for any follow-ups.
StreamBot: Recording started. File: all-hands-1769001234.mp4. Live viewers: 12 (prestream).
Allen: :raised_hands: woo
Ashley P: OBS reported dropped frame at 10:07 during the prestream, bitrate spike in the log: `rtmp_close: 1`. Switching to backup bitrate 3500 kbps now.
Jordan: if US edge error spikes >5% ops, please prep failover to eu-west as fallback.
OpsBot: failover policy armed. Will switch to eu-west-2 after 30s sustained error and notify on-call.
Emily R: adding a recording marker at 10:08 for the brief drop so editor knows where to look.
Mike L: can we keep raw audio + mixed audio exports? I need to clip the drop region for the product video.
Sara K: posting the async Q&A doc link now so folks can add questions during the stream: https://redwood.app/allhands/qa-1769001234
Jordan: will post slide deck + Q&A link in #general after the meeting. Also reminder to add follow-ups to the retro board.
StreamBot: Recording stopped. File uploaded: s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/1769001234.mp4. Transcode started.
OpsBot: Transcode complete. 1080p mp4 and captions available at https://files.redwood/recordings/1769001234. Checksums matched.
Ashley P: thanks — I'll compare the audio tracks and flag if we need a reprocess.
Jordan: huge thanks to everyone who helped triage prestream. We'll circle on action items in the retro tomorrow.
